Root objective: Mission 03-ambiguous-analytics, slice 01-analytics-v2 (OPR.99.0.4.1, tier high, wave w1 alone). Intent: An Analyst gets the click analytics marketing actually needs, with what is counted, how long clicks are kept, what the hashed address may be used for and who reads the figures decided by the human before anything is built, then built and proven on top of the shipped v1. Human's plan-lock decision (2026-10-03T15:40Z, verbatim): approve: one slice 01-analytics-v2 in one wave; park the analytics questions on me before design. DECISION FIRST: the requirements step writes the ambiguity log (what is counted: raw vs unique, bots; retention: keep 90 days, change, aggregate old clicks; privacy: what the daily-salted client hash may be used for; who reads the figures: API, report, dashboard; time zones), each with options, a recommended default and its consequence, and parks it on human@kernel (rig queue block <packet> --on human@kernel ... --evidence-ref <SPEC path>). Nothing is designed or built before the answer is recorded verbatim in the SPEC. Priority: this slice's requirements go first on the requirements seat, because the human is online now. Input for the privacy question (mission 01 wave review W2-02): the click hook hashes the connection address (ClickRecorder.java:86) while the rate limiter follows X-Forwarded-For from configured trusted proxies; behind a configured proxy every client shares one hash; if the answer uses the hash for uniques, aligning click identity with the trusted-proxy rule is part of the build, and hashes already stored cannot be separated later. Shipped v1: missions/01-greenfield-core/slices/02-analytics (merged 091ff46; ADR-0011..0013). Brownfield: design writes impact-analysis.md over v1 before design.md. Cross-mission rule: mission 02 builds the 90-day click purge on click/ and takes migration numbers in parallel; this slice's plan-lock (the lead's, D11) checks main's migration head and mission 02's in-flight click/ work, the later plan-lock takes the next free V number and the later implement rebases onto main. If the decided scope is more than one outcome, the lead adds slices. Territory (a prediction until the decision): click/ main, unit, functional; db/migration only if stored data changes; docs/api/openapi.json; docs/diagrams/erd.mmd; application.properties only for a new operator setting; not link/, web/, audit/. Any functional test that shifts FunctionalClock sends its shifted requests from a dedicated peer address (the rate limiter keeps that peer's bucket after reset). Worktree .worktrees/01-analytics-v2 on slice/01-analytics-v2 from main f6dd29e. Read first: missions/03-ambiguous-analytics/SPEC.md, its NOTES.md, the slice slice.yaml and SPEC.md.

Step objective: Write the slice SPEC.md: user stories, GIVEN/WHEN/THEN acceptance criteria, business rules, scope, ambiguity log, proof contract. Park a real ambiguity on the human; otherwise record safe defaults.

summary: Analytics v2: six decisions before design (SPEC at 88d87a9). Reply with letters, or 'accept all recommended' = Q1 B, Q2 B, Q3 B, Q4 A, Q5 A, Q6 A. Q1 What is counted: A raw clicks only (v1) / B add unique visitors per UTC day [rec] / C also weekly or monthly uniques (needs Q2 C). Q2 What may the daily-salted client hash be used for: A nothing (v1) / B distinct visitors within its own UTC day only, never exposed or joined [rec] / C longer-lived identity, weakens privacy. Under B the build aligns click identity with the trusted-proxy rule, because behind a configured proxy every visitor shares the proxy's hash today (wave review W2-02); no such hashes exist on the loopback deployment. Q3 Bots: A count all (v1) / B add bot clicks per day beside unchanged figures [rec] / C exclude bots from every figure. Q4 Retention: A keep 90 days then delete, as mission 02 builds it [rec; totalClicks and the per-day series become a rolling 90-day window] / B different number of days / C roll old clicks into per-day counts kept indefinitely, then delete rows (+slice; changes mission 02's purge). Q5 Who reads: A the existing stats API only, fields added [rec] / B plus CSV export / C HTML dashboard (+slice) / D cross-link top links (+slice). Q6 Day boundary: A UTC only [rec; keeps per-day uniques exact] / B time-zone parameter / C operator-configured zone (B and C double-count uniques across salt days).
